description: Implementation of internal memory utility functions for string manipulation in the Abseil library, including functions like memcasecmp, memdup, memrchr, memspn, memcspn, mempbrk, and memmatch.

methods.name: memcasecmp
methods.description: Performs case-insensitive comparison of two memory blocks.

methods.name: memrchr
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a character in a memory block.

methods.name: memspn
methods.description: Calculates the length of the initial segment of s consisting only of characters in accept.

methods.name: memcspn
methods.description: Calculates the length of the initial segment of s consisting only of characters not in reject.

methods.name: mempbrk
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence in s of any character from accept.

methods.name: memmatch
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a needle in haystack.
